worker_target_description: Primary article experiment: p. 11 correlational analysis comparing relationship-satisfaction/general-life-satisfaction correlations in the general-specific control and one-specific-general condition without joint lead-in; the page reports z = 2.32 for this difference. This is the sole reported test statistic on the supplied locator page, rather than an arbitrary selection among Table I correlations.
worker_notes: Identity assessment: supplied SSOAR text is not merely the 1990 working-paper cover. It includes a notice that the attached reprint replaces ZUMA-Arbeitsbericht No. 90/01, identifies Schwarz, Strack, & Mai (1991), Public Opinion Quarterly 55, 3–23, and then contains the matching article title, authors, Method, Results, tables and references on printed pp. 3–23. DOI is not legibly printed in the supplied OCR; title/authors/year/journal/pages establish the matching primary report. No PDF path was supplied, so no PDF rendering was possible. Only assigned n_o is completed; all other fields are placeholders. Target resolution uses the unique p. 11 reported test statistic (z = 2.32) and its explicitly described question-order contrast, not input order or numeric matching. Analytic N derivation: 50 + 50 = 100 respondents. Method explicitly assigns respondents to one of nine conditions; Table I states 50 per cell except joint lead-in (56). Neither target condition is joint lead-in. Other Table I coefficients and the joint-lead-in condition are not selected as the target. The printed recruitment total 456 is a different role and is not the critical-test N. The canonical OCR renders the table note as N - 50; quoted unchanged. No effect-size conversion or inference from degrees of freedom.
